settings.heading: Begin with proportion.
settings.body: Balance does not have to mean symmetry.

settings.heading: Choose a focal point.
settings.body:
Start with the strongest shape in the outfit. It might be a defined shoulder, a full trouser or a fluid hem. Give that shape room to speak by keeping its neighboring pieces simpler.

Try a structured jacket over a clean layer. Or pair a draped top with a more direct line below. The contrast is what makes the silhouette interesting.

settings.heading: Look at the whole line.
settings.body:
Step back from individual pieces and consider where the outfit begins and ends. Shoe shape, sleeve length and the position of a hem can change how the proportions read.

There is no single correct formula. Use the mirror to notice which combinations feel comfortable and distinctly yours.
